name: camellia sinensis leaf + coconut oil + salicylic acid + urea
uses: Use 1.Clean and dry skin that needs moisturizing 2. Take an appropriate amount of cream and apply it evenly on the skin 3. Massage gently in circular motions with your hands until absorbed. 4. Use it daily to get better results
otcwarn: Do not use in large quantities, particularly over raw surfaces or blistered areas. on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns Ask Doctor irritation or rash appears or if it persists after discontinuing use. Stop Use irritation or rash appears or if it persists after discontinuing use.
